subject: Communication Systems - Information Theory and Coding
explanation_text: According to the Plotkin bound. [latex] \begin{aligned} d_{\min } &\leq \frac{n 2^{k-1}}{2^{k}-1}\\ n&= \text{ Length of each code word }\\ k&= \text{ Length of each message word} \\ \text{Given that.}\\ d_{\min }&=2 \text { and } n=5\\ \text{So, } \frac{2^{k}}{2\left(2^{k}-1\right)} &\geq \frac{2}{5} \\ \frac{2^{k}}{2^{k}-1} &\geq \frac{4}{5} \end{aligned}[/latex] For any value of k, the above bound will be  satisfied. But as [latex]n > k[/latex] and n is fixed at 5. The maximum value of k that can be selected is 4. So, the maximum number of codewords possible is [latex]2_{4} = 16[/latex].
